checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 6-second landscape 16:9 video of a mountain lake at dusk
must.why: The frames show a dusk mountain lake. The size is about 826x496, close to 16:9, and the clip is 6 s.

must.item: Gentle ripples visibly animate the water
must.why: The reflections and surface lines change between frames. Most of the change comes from the clouds, not from ripples.

must.item: Camera fixed, no pans, zooms or cuts
must.why: The mountains and horizon stay in the same place in every frame.

must.item: No perceptible jump or reset at the loop boundary
must.why: The 5.7 s frame is close to the 0.6 s frame, so the loop probably matches. The clouds go from a heavy mass at 2.4 s to almost none at 5.7 s. This fast change could look odd on repeat, and I could not play the loop.

must.item: Centre stays calm, with no prominent moving objects competing with a heading
must.why: A large dark cloud bank grows across the centre of the sky at 2.4 s and then breaks up. It is not subtle and would sit behind the heading.

must.item: No visible text and no audible sound
must.why: No text appears in any frame. The assistant said the clip has no sound.

faults.what: Dark clouds form out of a clear sky and then dissolve, like a time-lapse. This is far from the subtle motion the user asked for, and it sits in the centre where the heading goes.
The reflection changes a lot as the clouds change. The water looks like it is morphing, not rippling gently.
The resolution is soft and the frame is not exactly 16:9.

summary: The clip is a pretty fixed-camera dusk lake, but a heavy cloud bank forms and dissolves in the centre. That breaks the "subtle" brief and the clear space for a heading, and the ripples are minimal.
